描述_EN: there is much less detail on the back of the figure, suggesting it was made to be viewed from the front. it has been cast of an alloy of copper and zinc using the 'lost-wax' method (a method of hollow casting that requires wax) and then fire-gilded (a process involving mercury in the gilding). many luohans have strongly characterised faces, as we can see with this figure. along the east and west walls of the main hall in many buddhist temples in china are rows of seated luohans. this is a fine figure of a luohan, or disciple of the buddha. these disciples can number as many as 500, but are usually found in temples in groups of 16 or 18, each with his own distinctive appearance and name.
描述_ZN: 1988年¥该图背面的细节少得多，说明它是为了从正面看。 它是用 "失蜡法"（一种需要蜡的空心铸造法）用铜和锌的合金铸造的，然后用火镀金（一种在镀金中涉及汞的工艺）。 许多罗汉都有强烈的脸部特征，正如我们在这个图上看到的那样。 在中国许多佛教寺庙的大殿的东西两边墙上有一排坐着的罗汉。 这是一个精美的罗汉像，即佛祖的弟子。 这些弟子的人数可以达到500人，但通常在寺庙中以16或18人为一组，每个人都有自己独特的外表和名字。
